sources.scope: 129 valid, distinct official SanGIS unstacked reference polygons audited in thirteen bounded local cells near the WUP 2025 San Diego settlement locator. All required real-adapter checks passed across recorded attempts with explicit provider-timeout retries. No sampled overlaps above 0.01 m², duplicate geometry or invalid polygons were found. This is bounded San Diego-area source verification, not municipality-wide completeness or legal survey evidence. SanGIS uses one reference polygon per tax parcel; selected APNs may change, so runtime identity uses native PARCELID rather than APN.

cityScopes.encinitas: Bounded qualification around the UN DESA WUP 2025 settlement locator for Encinitas. Passing all eight gates and independent geometry audit supports local parcel integration only; citywide completeness, legal title, survey accuracy and currentness are not established.
